name: Fretless glide bass
desc: Melodic fretless-feel bass in Db major on a wavetable e-bass: singing lines with grace-note slides into chord tones, high approach fills at the turnaround, round mids and shape warmth. The session-cat low end under city pop and AOR.

code.sparse: note("<[db2@3 c2] [bb1@3 ab1] [gb1@2 ab1 bb1] [ab1@2 eb2 ab1]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_ebass").lpf(${tone}*.7).attack(.01).decay(.4).sustain(.45).release(.1).shape(.35).gain(${gain}*.8).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<[db2 ~ [c2 db2] ~ ab1 ~ f2 eb2] [bb1 ~ [a1 bb1] ~ f1 ~ db2 c2] [gb1 ~ [f1 gb1] ~ db2 ~ bb1 ab1] [ab1 ~ ab1 c2 eb2 ~ [d2 eb2] ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_ebass").lpf(${tone}).attack(.006).decay(.25).sustain(.3).release(.08).shape(.45).gain(${gain}).room(.08).every(8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.8)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[db2 db2 ~ [c2 db2] ab1 ~ f2 [eb2 f2]] [bb1 bb1 ~ [a1 bb1] f1 ~ db2 [c2 db2]] [gb1 gb1 ~ [f1 gb1] db2 ~ bb1 [ab1 bb1]] [ab1 ab1 c2 eb2 [d2 eb2] ~ gb2 [f2 eb2]]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_ebass").lpf(${tone}*1.3).attack(.005).decay(.2).sustain(.25).release(.06).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).room(.08).orbit(3).play()
